verifiedScope.proxy: Selected original-Japanese novel and novella book-publication window, from Snow Country to Beauty and Sadness, used as a publishing proxy, not a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. English titles identify Japanese editions, not translation dates. Snow Country began appearing in magazines in 1935; the marker uses its first 1937 book, before later expansion. Thousand Cranes and The Sound of the Mountain began serial publication in 1949. Their markers use the 1952 Thousand Cranes volume and the completed standalone 1954 Sound of the Mountain; the 1952 volume also contained earlier Mountain material. The remaining markers use the 1961, 1962 and 1965 Japanese books, not composition or earlier serialization. Earlier fiction, stories, essays, later editions and posthumous books fall outside this selection; Dandelions appeared in September 1972, after his April death, and does not extend the bar.
